description: Feed Descarcare Conducte is a dataset listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by transgaz.ro. According to "TG for INSPIRE Download services 3.1", chapter 5 "Atom implementation of the download service of predefined datasets" a GML file containing the data related to a piece of pipeline was generated. Coverage: RO. The portal shows the English title as "Atom Feed Download Pipelines" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in OTHER. The listing shows 2018-05-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
